content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] controller with article number [article_no] and firmware version [version_no]. I would like to know if it's possible to update the firmware to [version_no] or higher to use [product_name] editor software and what the correct upgrade procedure would be.
Please write your posts in English. Thank you.

As far as I know, updating a [product_name] controller with firmware [version_no] to [version_no] is not possible. The [version_no] firmware is only compatible with models with article number [article_no].

Hello, I have a [product_name] controller with article number [article_no] and firmware version [version_no]. Can I upgrade the firmware to [version_no] or a newer version to use [product_name] editor software? What is the proper procedure for this upgrade?
Is it possible to use the [product_name] editor software with firmware version [version_no]?
You can access the web server, but only the basic web server functionality. The advanced web server, which allows user-defined web pages, is not available.
If the advanced web server is unavailable, can you use [product_name] editor software to simulate digital inputs online?

The [product_name] editor software is meant for creating user-defined websites. The extended web server displays these custom sites in a browser. With your [product_name] controller, only the basic web server is available. This allows you to view a virtual display of the controller or operator device, including a virtual cursor and function keys.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges upgrading the firmware of their [product_name] hardware from [version_no] to a newer release, limiting compatibility with the [product_name] editor software. The discussion reveals uncertainty regarding firmware upgrade options and confusion about web server functionalities for various firmware versions. There are also misconceptions about simulating inputs or accessing advanced web features with older firmware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to upgrade their [product_name] firmware from [version_no] to a newer version to enable use of the [product_name] editor software, as well as access enhanced web server features and simulation functionalities.
